style_suffix: Realistic historical oil painting, painterly brushwork with soft edges, desaturated palette of umber, ochre, slate grey and muted crimson, weathered authentic materials, 13th-century Northern European setting, cinematic composition, subtle film grain, no text, no lettering, no watermark.

characters.uncle: Duke Edric, a man in his mid-fifties with silver-streaked dark hair swept back, a trimmed grey beard, heavy-lidded calm eyes, wearing a fur-lined deep green velvet robe, a gold signet ring with a green stone on his right hand
characters.liana: Princess Liana, a slender young woman of about nineteen, long auburn hair in a single loose braid, pale skin, grey eyes, a plain dark blue wool gown, a thin silver circlet
characters.martha: Martha, a widow in her early fifties, weathered sun-lined face, grey-streaked brown hair under a linen coif, a patched brown wool dress and apron, calloused hands, a small pin shaped like an ear of wheat on her collar
characters.varen: Varen the spymaster, a lean clean-shaven man in his forties, short black hair, sharp nose, narrow watchful eyes, black leather doublet under a dark grey cloak, a small silver key pendant
characters.oswald: Oswald the treasurer, a portly bald man of about sixty with a white fringe of hair, red-rimmed eyes, burgundy robes, ink-stained fingers, a brass chain of office
characters.roland: Roland, captain of the guard, a broad-shouldered man in his forties with a pale scar across his chin, mail hauberk under a blue surcoat bearing a silver tower
characters.king: the young king, seen only from behind or as hands in frame, dark blue mantle with a silver tower embroidered at the shoulder, a plain gold crown

heraldry.kingdom: royal heraldry: a silver tower on deep blue
heraldry.eastmark: Eastmark heraldry: a white stag on dark red
heraldry.brotherhood: the brotherhood's sign: a bound sheaf of wheat
